scope: Theorem 6.10 (Stationary free extension) of the manuscript “Eventual categoricity for abstract elementary classes” (preprints/Eventual-Categoricity-for-Abstract-Elementary-Classes-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 240 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dcb7401285f5ac78), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 45. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A → B be an arrow at a sufficiently closed level and let p = tp(v/A), where |v| ≤ σ. There is a specified actual type pB over B, called its free lift, extending p. At every desired query size whose approximation and testing costs are bounded at the originating level, it is computed by transporting sufficiently long approximations in A. At one level this includes every bounded query size; in a mixed-level use the costs must remain below the level of A. It has the following properties. 1. The answer is independent of the approximation sequence, its length, and the auxiliary test size used in its construction. 2. Free lifts commute with restriction of the tuple, are invariant under isomorphisms, and satisfy (pB)C = pC whenever A → B → C. 3. If A has an eligible size ν and B has a larger eligible size, the construction still works for |v| < ν, with its construction thresholds and approximation lists below ν. The restriction to A is the actual ν-type of Corollary 6.7. 4. A sequence from Lemma 6.9 at the fixed threshold c(σ) is bounded code data. If an equally indexed sequence in any sufficiently closed eligible object has the same diagram, it determines a unique corresponding type there by the same majority prescription. Arrows carrying one such sequence to another carry the corresponding type to its free lift. In particular an isomorphism carrying the code sequence transports the type. We say that an actual type over B is free from A when it is the free lift of its restriction to A.
